fields.mechanism: Advanced characterization techniques including X-ray imaging, optical sensing, acoustic field imaging, and spectroscopy to study thermal runaway (TR) mechanism
fields.intervention: Implement multi-modal sensing system within battery pack using optical sensors and acoustic monitors to detect early signs of thermal runaway in individual cells
fields.expected_effect: Early detection of thermal runaway initiation in individual cells before propagation to adjacent cells, allowing for suppression systems to activate
fields.falsification_test: Simulate thermal runaway in isolated battery cell while monitoring detection system response time and suppression effectiveness in preventing propagation to adjacent cells

fields.falsification_test: Heat a single cell in a controlled test pack while measuring temperature propagation to adjacent cells with and without the isolation materials
